title: NeoBabel: A Multilingual Open Tower for Visual Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving multilingual performance and cross-lingual consistency in image generation. While it discusses 'digital inequities' and 'cultural fidelity' as motivations, the core evaluation and benchmarking metrics (m-GenEval, m-DPG, CLC, and CSS) are centered on linguistic and visual alignment rather than religion, faith, or ethical/moral frameworks.
